proposals.evidence: DEDR 5270 explicitly gives Brahui banning, Gondi vā-, Kolami var-/va-, Gadaba var- with imperative vā, Malto bare and Telugu rā- come. The survey cognacy annotation identifies this article and full-article comparison verifies these stems/allomorphs; the short imperative responses are not silently expanded to citation forms. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 561 documents Kannada ugur, Kodagu oy, Gondi gōr, Kurukh orox, Kuwi gōru with plural gōrka, Malto orgu and Toda ǖr as the nail/claw family. Survey final vowels and plural-looking material remain unchanged. Badaga ugilə is a comparative extension explicitly described as a look-alike in the source; Kodagu voyi and Toda yūr retain their initial glide/transcription differences. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
